articles.title: Schwab Total Client Assets Jump 17.6% Y/Y in January Despite Lower NNA
articles.mainIdea: Schwab Total Client Assets Jump 17.6% Y/Y in January Despite Lower NNA
articles.summary: Zacks: Schwab Total Client Assets Jump 17.6% Y/Y in January Despite Lower NNA. SCHW reports $12.15T in client assets in January, up 17.6% Y/Y, even as core net new assets slid 9.2%.

articles.summary: CNN Business: Why the ‘AI scare trade’ might not be done. A sell-off rippled through software, real estate and trucking stocks this past week as investors worried artificial intelligence could upend some industries — and analysts say the white-knuckle drops might not be over yet.
